scripts.deploy: sam build && sam deploy && npm run deploy:web
scripts.deploy:prod: sam build && sam deploy --config-env prod && npm --prefix web run build && node scripts/web.mjs deploy what-time-prod
scripts.deploy:web: npm --prefix web run build && node scripts/web.mjs deploy what-time
scripts.invoke: sam build && sam local invoke TimeFunction -e events/event.json
scripts.destroy: node scripts/web.mjs empty what-time && sam delete
